overview.primary_signal.panel.title: Primary Signal
overview.primary_signal.panel.summary: Every 15 minutes the Futures engine checks BTCUSDT, scores LONG and SHORT independently, and decides whether either side is actionable.
details: Signal shows the latest result of that check, usually LONG, SHORT, or NO_SIGNAL.
If LONG or SHORT is active, Entry, TP, and SL show the planned trade structure for the current setup.
Entry Status tells you whether the trade was opened, blocked, or simply not ready.
overview.primary_signal.panel.secondary_cta_label: See execution-side details in Trade Outcomes

overview.signal_context.panel.title: Signal Context by Timeframe
overview.signal_context.panel.summary: This block helps you see whether the current market picture is aligned or mixed across the main timeframes.
details: 5m reacts first and shows short-term pressure.
15m is the main decision timeframe behind the Primary Signal on this page.
4h shows the broader backdrop behind the short-term move.
When these timeframes point in the same direction, the signal has cleaner support.
When they disagree, the market picture is mixed and the setup is usually less convincing.

overview.portfolio_snapshot.panel.title: Portfolio Snapshot
overview.portfolio_snapshot.panel.summary: This block shows Futures capital, margin usage, open exposure, and current PnL.
details: Equity shows where the account stands now against the original starting capital.
Annualized Return translates current progress into an annualized pace from strategy start.
Net Return % shows the direct cumulative return from start, while Open Positions shows how many trades are live.
Total Net PnL and Unrealized PnL split realized performance from still-open movement.

overview.trade_outcomes_snapshot.panel.title: Trade Outcomes Snapshot
overview.trade_outcomes_snapshot.panel.summary: This block gives the fastest read on Futures trade activity: open positions, closed positions, TP/SL hits, and force-close events.
details: Total Positions shows all recorded positions the system has created so far.
Closed Positions and Open Positions split that total into finished trades and still-active trades.
TP Hits and SL Hits show how finished trades have ended.
Force Close Events shows how many trades were closed by safety or fallback logic instead of normal TP/SL completion.
overview.trade_outcomes_snapshot.panel.cta_label: See full trade history in Portfolio
overview.trade_outcomes_snapshot.panel.secondary_cta_label: See execution-side details in Trade Outcomes

overview.trade_outcomes_snapshot.force_c.title: Force Close
overview.trade_outcomes_snapshot.force_c.summary: Important: number of Futures positions closed by protective fallback logic, not by normal TP/SL completion.
details: A force close is triggered when safety conditions require immediate exit!
These exits are tracked separately to show risk-control behavior.
Higher values can indicate unstable conditions or stricter protection behavior.

overview.strategy_snapshot.panel.title: Strategy Snapshot
overview.strategy_snapshot.panel.summary: Full-history signal mix and conversion, aligned with Strategy Edge.
details: Total Signals shows how many decision cycles produced a recorded signal since strategy start.
LONG Signals, SHORT Signals, and No Signal show the split between actionable entries and stand-aside outcomes.
Denied Entries shows how many directional decisions were blocked by execution rules after strategy logic passed.
Trades Opened and Conversion Rate show how often directional signals became real trades.
overview.strategy_snapshot.panel.cta_label: See full signal diagnostics in Strategy Edge

overview.equity_chart.panel.title: Equity Δ% from Start
overview.equity_chart.panel.summary: This chart shows how account equity has moved away from the starting capital over time.
details: The line rises when total equity grows above the original capital baseline.
It falls when the account moves below that starting point.
This is a trend view, not a single-trade view, so it is best used to judge direction over time rather than one isolated event.

overview.primary_signal.entry_status.title: Entry Status
overview.primary_signal.entry_status.summary: Shows whether the latest LONG/SHORT setup opened, was denied by permission rules, or never became actionable.
details: Opened means an order was actually filled and turned into a live position.
Denied means the signal passed strategy logic but failed at least one execution permission rule!
When Denied appears, check Main Blocker in Strategy Edge or the terminal output to see the exact hard blocker!
Blocked by Logic means market conditions were not ready for an actionable entry before execution permission was checked.
No Action means there was no live trade event to execute or reject.

overview.primary_signal.main_blocker.title: Main Blocker
overview.primary_signal.main_blocker.summary: The first execution-permission reason that stopped a selected Futures signal from opening.
details: Main Blocker is not the same as a missing gate.
Missing gates reduce signal quality; hard blockers stop execution after a signal is selected.
Common trading blockers are Entry timing blocked, Outside short zone, Long into resistance, Cooldown active, and Too close to recent entry.
If Main Blocker is empty, permission did not stop the latest selected setup.

portfolio.capital_snapshot.panel.title: Capital Snapshot
portfolio.capital_snapshot.panel.summary: Live Futures capital state: equity, margin, reserved funds, leverage exposure, and current PnL.
details: Equity shows current account value versus starting capital.
Reserved Capital tracks funds tied to open positions.
Unrealized PnL shows open-position movement not yet realized.

portfolio.open_positions.panel.title: Open Positions
portfolio.open_positions.panel.summary: Live positions with entry, notional, margin, TP/SL, and unrealized performance.
details: Only currently open trades appear here.
Unrealized PnL updates with live price movement.

portfolio.open_positions.unreal_pct.title: Unreal %
portfolio.open_positions.unreal_pct.summary: Unrealized PnL as a percentage of position notional.
details: Formula: Unrealized PnL / Notional * 100.
Shows movement versus total leveraged position size.

portfolio.open_positions.roe_pct.title: ROE %
portfolio.open_positions.roe_pct.summary: Unrealized PnL as a percentage of margin (your allocated capital).
details: Formula: Unrealized PnL / Margin * 100.
At x5 leverage, ROE is roughly 5x notional return before fees.

portfolio.closed_positions.panel.title: Closed Positions
portfolio.closed_positions.panel.summary: Completed Futures positions with confirmed exit time, outcome, and force-close flag.
details: Net result includes realized PnL after execution.
Force Close flags exits handled outside the normal TP/SL path!

portfolio.closed_trade_pnl.panel.title: Closed Trade PnL
portfolio.closed_trade_pnl.panel.summary: Per-trade net PnL across confirmed closed positions.
details: Each point represents one finished trade.
Use this to spot streaks or volatility in outcomes.

trade_outcomes.summary.panel.title: Trade Outcomes
trade_outcomes.summary.panel.summary: Closed-trade result summary for executed futures trades.
details: TP/SL counts are based on confirmed closed trades.
Win Rate uses TP vs SL outcomes only.

trade_outcomes.gate_effectiveness.panel.title: Gate Effectiveness
trade_outcomes.gate_effectiveness.panel.summary: Which gates appear most often in directional setups, and how those gates align with TP/SL outcomes.
details: Gate counts are computed from closed trades only.
Win Rate is TP divided by TP + SL for trades that used the gate.

trade_outcomes.gates.long.title: LONG Gates
trade_outcomes.gates.long.summary: Gate performance for executed LONG futures trades only.
details: Primary rows are direction filters such as MTF, regime, and trend.
Confirm rows are supporting checks such as momentum, orderbook, and structure.
Counts come from closed LONG trades, not theoretical signals.

trade_outcomes.gates.short.title: SHORT Gates
trade_outcomes.gates.short.summary: Gate performance for executed SHORT futures trades only.
details: Primary rows are bearish direction filters such as MTF, regime, and trend.
Confirm rows are supporting bearish checks such as momentum, orderbook, and structure.
Counts come from closed SHORT trades, not theoretical signals.

strategy_edge.summary.panel.title: Strategy Edge
strategy_edge.summary.panel.summary: Signal-side testing across the full history, without execution-layer interference.
details: Counts include all recorded signals since strategy start.
Theoretical TP/SL uses signal-side logic only.

strategy_edge.summary.theoretical_tp.title: Theoretical TP
strategy_edge.summary.theoretical_tp.summary: Signals that would have reached the planned take-profit in signal-side simulation.
details: This is not the count of real executed trade TP hits.
It ignores execution permission blocks, cooldown, proximity, and live portfolio state.
Use it to judge signal logic quality before execution rules are applied.

strategy_edge.summary.theoretical_sl.title: Theoretical SL
strategy_edge.summary.theoretical_sl.summary: Signals that would have reached the planned stop-loss in signal-side simulation.
details: This is not the count of real executed trade SL hits.
It shows how often raw signal setups failed after their planned TP/SL was projected.
Compare it with Theoretical TP and real Trade Outcomes before changing rules.

strategy_edge.summary.theoretical_open.title: Theoretical Open
strategy_edge.summary.theoretical_open.summary: Signals whose theoretical TP/SL path has not resolved to TP or SL yet.
details: These are signal-side placeholders that remain unresolved in the recorded evaluation window.
They are not necessarily live open positions.
Real open positions are shown on the Portfolio page.

strategy_edge.gates.long.title: LONG Gates
strategy_edge.gates.long.summary: Gate performance for theoretical LONG futures setups.
details: Primary rows are direction filters such as MTF, regime, and trend.
Confirm rows are supporting checks such as momentum, orderbook, and structure.
This is signal-side analysis, so execution permission blocks are not included.

strategy_edge.gates.short.title: SHORT Gates
strategy_edge.gates.short.summary: Gate performance for theoretical SHORT futures setups.
details: Primary rows are bearish direction filters such as MTF, regime, and trend.
Confirm rows are supporting bearish checks such as momentum, orderbook, and structure.
This is signal-side analysis, so execution permission blocks are not included.

strategy_edge.gate_effectiveness.panel.title: Gate Effectiveness
strategy_edge.gate_effectiveness.panel.summary: How each gate lines up with theoretical TP/SL outcomes across signal history.
details: Uses the same TP/SL simulation rules as Strategy Edge.
Win Rate is TP divided by TP + SL for signals that used the gate.

strategy_edge.recent_signals.panel.title: Recent Signal Decisions
strategy_edge.recent_signals.panel.summary: Latest recorded Futures signal outcomes, including execution permission status and the visible hard blocker.
details: Passed Gates shows the checks that agreed with the setup at decision time.
Missing Gates shows the checks that did not agree.
Entry Status shows whether the setup opened, was denied by execution rules, or had no actionable setup.
Main Blocker shows the first execution-permission reason when a directional signal was denied!
A row can have a strong LONG/SHORT score and still be denied if a hard blocker fails.

strategy_edge.entry_status.column.title: Entry Status
strategy_edge.entry_status.column.summary: Whether the selected Futures signal opened, was denied by permission, or had no executable action.
details: Opened means the signal became a simulated position.
Denied means the signal passed strategy selection but failed an execution permission rule!
No Action or Blocked by Logic means the setup did not reach execution permission.

strategy_edge.main_blockers.panel.title: Hard Blockers
strategy_edge.main_blockers.panel.summary: Execution rules that can stop a selected Futures signal from becoming a real position.
details: Entry timing blocked means the move is late or exhausted. EXHAUSTED_MOVE remains blocked.
Outside short zone means the SHORT is outside the market-plan working zone, unless the tested breakdown-continuation override applies.
Long into resistance means the LONG entry is already extended upward into resistance.
Cooldown active, Too close to recent entry, Weak open position, and Liquidation buffer are risk-control blockers.
Capital, Exposure, Position limit, Direction limit, Duplicate position, Manual block, and Missing data are account or operations blockers.

orderbook.snapshot.panel.title: Orderflow Snapshot
orderbook.snapshot.panel.summary: Recent flow pressure, cumulative delta, and latest buy/sell imbalance.
details: Buy/Sell pressure highlights short-term flow dominance.
Net delta shows the balance of aggressive buying vs selling.

orderbook.history.panel.title: Orderflow History
orderbook.history.panel.summary: Recent orderflow snapshots with per-interval delta and imbalance data.
details: Each row is one recorded snapshot.
Use this to trace short-term flow shifts over time.

orderbook.delta_chart.panel.title: Orderflow Delta Chart
orderbook.delta_chart.panel.summary: Net delta bars and cumulative delta line across recent orderflow snapshots.
details: Bars show per-interval net delta.
The line tracks cumulative buying vs selling pressure.
